messages:
Zoe: Heads-up ap-south-1 warm pool is stuck at 5/40 and we're seeing a spike in ephemeral port exhaustion + KMS decrypt failures since the NACL tighten rolled at 01:05 UTC. Anyone on network?
Kofi: I'm on it. I can see a burst of short TCP sessions to kms.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com and s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com originating from gpu-subnet. NACL denies show up in the flow logs.
Hana: The NACL change was to lock down ephemeral ranges as part of SOC audit: `deny 1024-65535 from 0.0.0.0/0` on the outbound rules for certain subnets. We intended to require an egress proxy but that rollout wasn't completed for gpu-subnet.
oncall-sre: Conntrack and ephemeral port metrics: `ephemeral_used: 49180 / 49152` and `nf_conntrack_entries: 402k / 420k`. Seeing many `SYN_RECV` -> `RST` due to denied egress.
Zoe: That explains KMS decrypt 403s (fallback flows). Nodes retry fast and open new sockets -> port exhaustion. Short-term: we should 1) relax the NACL ephemeral block only for gpu-subnet, 2) bump conntrack and ephemeral range on nodes as mitigation, 3) roll the egress-proxy sooner.
Kofi: Agree. I'll patch the NACL to allow ephemeral ports 1024-65535 for the gpu-subnet CIDR and tag it with `temp:allow-ephemeral`. Applying now.
DeployBot: NACL patch started by Kofi (run_id=apply-2026-03-22-02:18).
DeployBot: NACL patch completed (run_id=apply-2026-03-22-02:19)  changed 1 rule.
oncall-sre: After patch, ephemeral_used dropped: 49.1k -> 12.3k in 3m, conntrack entries falling. Warm pool recovered to 26/40.
Hana: Follow-up long-term: 1) finish egress-proxy with connection pooling and TLS passthrough so nodes don't hit external KMS directly, 2) update SOC rollout notes so NACL changes depend on proxy flag, 3) add preflight integration test that simulates heavy keystore retry storms.
Zoe: Also: add rate-limit on keystore client retries and jitter to avoid synchronized storms. Ticketed as INFRA-5042.
Kofi: I'll own the NACL revert cleanup (remove `temp:allow-ephemeral` once proxy is live) and the runbook entry. Opening PR infra/network#237.
AuditBot: Notice: 3200 denied egress flows to kms.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com in 10m before patch (rule=nacl-tighten-2026).
Zoe: Good catch. Monitoring for 2h. If ephemeral_used > 80% again, escalate to network oncall and SOC.
